title: Pre-existing clippy::type_complexity error in jmap-jscontact-types test code at lib.rs:1735 (complex tuple type for AnniversaryDate test cases)
description:
crate-jmap-jscontact-types/src/lib.rs:1735 fails `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` with:

    error: very complex type used. Consider factoring parts into `type` definitions
       --> crate-jmap-jscontact-types/src/lib.rs:1735:20
        |
    1735 |         let cases: &[(&str, serde_json::Value, fn(&AnniversaryDate) -> bool)] = &[

This was confirmed pre-existing (reproduces on `main` at 2eb8fdf without any uncommitted changes) and is independent of bd:JMAP-ic0j.71. The fix is either:

  (a) Factor the tuple into a `type` alias (e.g. `type AnniversaryDateCase = (&'static str, serde_json::Value, fn(&AnniversaryDate) -> bool);`).
  (b) `#[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]` on the test fn.

Option (a) is the standard fix; the alias is reusable if other tests in the file have the same shape. Out of scope for JMAP-ic0j.71; filed as a separate cleanup.

Likely surfaced by a recent clippy version bump (the `unnecessary_cast` error in id.rs:295 caught in the same workspace clippy run was also a 1.95+ lint, suggesting toolchain rev was the trigger).
close_reason: Batch 11: committed and adversarially verified (or already fixed); CI green at cc87669d
